primary_test.name: stratified_exact_random_addition_rescue_test
primary_test.conditioning: Within each scored race, condition on field size, M candidate count, number of actual top-three finishers outside M, and the exact number of additional union candidates. Under the null, the additional union candidates are a uniformly random subset of the non-M runners. Convolve the race-specific hypergeometric rescue distributions exactly across all 20 races.
primary_test.test_statistic: total additional top-three hits rescued by union beyond M

operational_gate.metric: overall union candidate fraction across all scored starters
operational_gate.rationale: Pre-outcome ceiling to prevent a trivial recall gain from expanding toward the whole field. v3.1 development coverage was 0.5904; 0.65 is a fixed prospective ceiling with limited headroom.

formal_decision_rule.PROMOTE: After exactly 20 scored eligible races, one-sided exact random-addition p <= 0.05 AND overall candidate fraction <= 0.65 AND freeze success rate >= 0.80.
formal_decision_rule.NO_PROMOTION: After exactly 20 scored eligible races, fail any of the statistical evidence, candidate-fraction, or technical-evaluability gates.
formal_decision_rule.INCOMPLETE: Before 20 scored eligible races. Interim statistics are descriptive only and cannot trigger promotion or threshold changes.

secondary_descriptive_metrics: additional candidates per additional top-three hit
multiplicity: No secondary metric is confirmatory. No multiplicity-adjusted secondary hypothesis testing is preregistered.
no_tuning_rule: Do not change M/C1/U/Q1/K1 thresholds, rescue logic, market observation window, eligibility, alpha, or candidate-fraction ceiling during the 20-race holdout.
data_failure_rule: Every chronologically eligible race must be recorded in the attempt ledger as FROZEN or PRE_RESULT_DATA_FAILURE. Pre-result technical/data failures do not enter the scored performance denominator, but they do enter the technical-evaluability denominator. Performance is never a reason to mark a race non-evaluable.
claim_ceiling: A PROMOTE decision supports candidate-generation usefulness relative to same-size random expansion of M at Kyoto under this holdout population. It does not establish calibrated probabilities, positive expected betting value, or generalization outside Kyoto.

technical_evaluability_gate.metric: freeze_success_rate among all chronologically eligible attempts through the 20th scored FROZEN race
technical_evaluability_gate.denominator: all eligible attempts, including PRE_RESULT_DATA_FAILURE, through the 20th scored freeze
technical_evaluability_gate.rationale: Pre-outcome gate to prevent selective retention of only races with convenient/complete data.
